component.name: StrmQt
component.summary: Watch your Emby library on the big screen

description.p: StrmQt is a native Qt 6 client for Emby media servers, built for KDE Plasma and designed to be driven from the couch with a remote, a gamepad, or the keyboard.

ul.li: Hardware-accelerated playback through libmpv, with libVLC as a fallback engine
Ten-foot interface: home rails, library grids, series drill-down, and search
Resume playback, watched state, and favourites synchronised with the server
MPRIS2 media controls, so KDE Connect and the Plasma applet just work
Credentials stored in KWallet, never in plain text on disk
HDR-aware tone mapping and screensaver inhibition during playback

description.p: The "first-party feel" release: mouse and pointer support throughout, live updates from the server, a play queue with shuffle and auto-advance, a full player OSD, library sorting and filtering, collections, playlists, person pages, remote control from other Emby clients, and music.
